verdicts.reason: A shrinks the three plan cards into tiny chips whose MONTHLY/YEARLY/FAMILY labels and 'per month' text can't be read. It also reorders them (6, 80, 48), moving the featured yearly plan to the end, and crams the subhead and legal copy into a ragged block on the right edge that is nearly as prominent as the message. B keeps the cards readable, in their original order and with all their labels, and gives the CTA a clear place. However, B's headline is too small for the hero, the subhead and legal text are very small, and the logo, headline and cards sit unevenly on the vertical axis, so it needs polish before it could ship.
